'''Bon Tapalo''', formally styled as '''His Royal Highness, King Tapalo of Naboo''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] of [[House Tapalo]] who served as [[Monarchy/Legends|Monarch]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] from c. [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]] to [[46 BBY/Legends|46 BBY]]. His reign saw his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] full transition into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a member world. Tapalo was later succeeded by [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] as [[King/Legends|King]] of Naboo.

==Biography==
===The election of 65 BBY===
In [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], Bon Tapalo was a front-runner in the election of the next [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Monarch of Naboo]]. Tapalo supported his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] complete integration into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Although much of the electorate agreed with Tapalo, the more conservative [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal Houses]] opposed the move for full membership, claiming that it would be at the expense of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] independence. While faced with opposition from the more elite factions of his own [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people]], Tapalo received strong support from outside sources&mdash;including mega-corporations such as [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]&mdash;that had an interest in Naboo, particularly the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] abundant [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] resource.<ref name="Plagueis" />

One of Tapalo's supporters was [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], the owner of Damask Holdings, who was secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Plagueis. Plagueis traveled to Naboo during the election where he learned that valuable information had been provided to Tapalo by an inside source within his opponent's camp. Plagueis then discovered that the mysterious contact was a young noble named [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the seventeen year-old son of [[Cosinga Palpatine]] and heir to [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]]. While Plagueis ultimately went on to claim Palpatine as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], Tapalo won the election and became king of Naboo.<ref name="Plagueis" />

===Reign===
Tapalo's reign&mdash;manipulated by Plagueis and other interest groups from behind the scenes&mdash;marked Naboo's assimilation into the [[The galaxy/Legends|greater galaxy]]. [[Outer Rim Construction and Assembly/Legends|Outer Rim Construction and Assembly]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] received contracts to export Naboo's plasma. Over time, however, the alliance came to be seen as exploitative and corrupt: isolationists like [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vidar Kim]] pointed out that the deal allowed the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to sell the plasma on at up to twenty times the price it paid the Naboo for it.<ref name="Plagueis" />

In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], Tapalo instructed Palpatine, now serving as [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], to abstain from a vote on seating several Trade Federation client worlds: many [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] had come to feel that the agreement for exports was exploitative, but with his own arrangements with the Trade Federation, and not wishing to break with Hego Damask, Tapalo did not wish to antagonise it. By abstaining from the vote, Naboo would appear to have stood up to galactic conglomerates, appeasing domestic concerns, while the Trade Federation's contracts remained unchanged. The whole affair was in fact conducted at Palpatine's suggestion to antagonise the Trade Federation and so in the future undermine Tapalo's successor, [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

Tapalo was later succeeded by his political ally, [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]]. Like Tapalo, Veruna also owed his throne to Plagueis' contributions to his election.<ref name="Plagueis" />

==Personality and traits==
Bon Tapalo was regarded by conservative factions as a corrupt politician and a radical reformer who wanted to sell out Naboo's independence to large corporations that were only interested in their planet's plasma. He was also not opposed to accepting political and financial support from wealthy off-world sources in order to secure his own election to the throne.<ref name="Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bon Tapalo first appeared in the novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="Plagueis" />
